no_equivalent.simpleCallback: cudaLaunchHostFunc/stream callbacks are not exposed by PyTorch and no prebuilt binary exists; a C++ build needs nvcc + MSVC, which the guest lacks
no_equivalent.simpleOccupancy: occupancy API sample needs a cudart C++ build (nvcc + MSVC); NVRTC/CuPy exposes no occupancy sample
no_equivalent.simpleIPC: CUDA IPC (cudaIpcGetMemHandle) is not supported on WDDM Windows (TCC/Linux only)
no_equivalent.cdpSimpleQuicksort: dynamic parallelism needs relocatable device code linked with cudadevrt; no prebuilt Windows binary and no NVRTC route without nvcc/MSVC
no_equivalent.hf_generate: dropped for size: transformers + tokenizers wheels and a 1 GB fp16 model; torch_correct/torch_ai_bench and the llama.cpp rows cover the same stacks
no_equivalent.geekbench_gpu: Geekbench needs the internet to upload results (the Linux pass string is 'Uploading results'); the lane forbids guest internet at run time
